stable.label: scratch-offscreen-world-tested
stable.note: The active /genesis-codehood/ route was rebuilt from scratch and no longer imports the V100-V110 layered simulation. Local deterministic tests pass; CI and deployed iPhone behavior are not yet promoted.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript module + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: deterministic continuous terrain heightfield with rock floor, basins, ocean shelf and inland ponds
conservative local-inertial shallow-water depth/discharge field with rain, infiltration and an ocean boundary reservoir
water-flow shear erodes soil into suspended sediment; slow water deposits sediment back into terrain
persistent soil moisture, nutrient and plant-root reinforcement fields
plants have persistent water, energy, biomass, growth, death and wind/rain bend state; their roots reinforce nearby soil
creatures have persistent five-node articulated bodies plus six two-segment legs using Verlet integration and distance constraints
creature movement uses authored body/leg actuation forces and physical terrain contacts rather than animation sprites
plant feeding requires the simulated mouth point to contact a plant before plant biomass transfers to creature energy
substantial water flow pushes creature bodies
the worker renders terrain, water, plants and creatures from the same simulation state on OffscreenCanvas
phone controls are drag, pinch, tap-select, pause, speed, rain, sound, regenerate and one-button clean view
approximations: water is a one-dimensional side-view shallow-water approximation, not 2D/3D Navier-Stokes CFD
terrain is a continuous 1D heightfield extruded visually into 2.5D; it does not yet support caves or overhang collision
creature physics is 2D Verlet/distance-constraint articulation with authored gait actuation, not rigid-body biomechanics or muscle physiology
feeding currently transfers contacted plant biomass directly into energy; there is no stomach/digestion model yet
plants are structural/growth state rendered procedurally, but roots are currently a reinforcement field rather than explicit root geometry
2.5D foreground/background depth is presentation ordering, not full 3D collision
procedural audio is sonification of rain/water telemetry, not acoustic wave simulation

legacy_ecosystem_stack.note: Previous V100-V110 and patch layers remain in repository history/files for reference but are not imported by the current /genesis-codehood/ page.

active_objective: Run independent CI on the clean scratch engine, then exercise the deployed OffscreenCanvas build on iPhone. If the visual result is still not acceptable, improve this clean engine rather than reintroducing the archived layered stack.
next_gate: CI_PASS requires both Codehood and Foundation workflows against the scratch engine. LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED require actual deployed browser/iPhone execution after that.
invariants: Active route must not import archived V100-V110 layers
No third-party runtime libraries in the scratch engine
Rendering must run through transferred OffscreenCanvas in the worker
Do not call shallow-water full CFD
Do not call authored gait muscle physiology
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
